body_lead: Andhra Pradesh To Introduce AI Tutor In Govt Schools Developed by IIT Madras, it will offer content in Telugu, English, and Hindi that can be accessed through a mobile app, web platform and WhatsApp. Amaravati: The Andhra Pradesh government is set to introduce an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Tutor for students in government schools. The digital learning platform, developed by IIT Madras, will be implemented on a pilot basis across select schools.
